rationale: Both independently find the same plausible unflagged WER double-resample bug and cover the audio_vae config-mutation and language/方言-removal concerns from the ground truth with good line-level grounding and actionable suggested diffs. But Y's top 'High' finding fabricates a claim that Qwen2Model.forward slices layers by config.num_hidden_layers at call time and backs it with fake 'verified locally' output, directly contradicting the PR author's own clarification (LHXuuu) that the encoder's actual layer count is unchanged — a serious precision failure that also casts doubt on Y's other 'confirmed by running it' claims. X correctly characterizes the same issue as stale config metadata with no found consumer, matching amy-why-3459's actual concern. Y edges recall slightly by explicitly echoing hsliuustc0106's 'refactor the env in the next release' layering complaint, which X misses in favor of a generic test-coverage ask.
